races.name: RacingTV Proudly Supports Teenage Cancer Trust Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
CAWTHORNE CRACKER is some time without a win but shaped well reverted to hurdling at Sedgefield last month and gets the nod over Fine Point and Scots Poet.

  1. CAWTHORNE CRACKER (IRE)
  2. FINE POINT (IRE)
  3. SCOTS POET

races.name: Borders Carers Centre Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
HOE JOLY SMOKE is never one for maximum faith on account of his weak finishing but he should still be good enough to follow up from his recent Bangor success. Handmedownastar will prove the biggest threat ahead of Hopeless Dancer.

  1. HOE JOLY SMOKE
  2. HANDMEDOWNASTAR (IRE)
  3. HOPELESS DANCER

races.name: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
LORIKO continues to carry all before him this summer, making it 4 wins from his last 5 starts at Sedgefield last week and Dan Skelton's 5-y-o gets the verdict to carry on his winning spree under a 6-lb penalty. Bold Light is a long time without a win, but he's become potentially well handicapped as a result so can provide most resistance, with Continuance rounding off the shortlist returned to calmer waters.

  1. LORIKO (FR)
  2. BOLD LIGHT (IRE)
  3. CONTINUANCE

races.name: Weatherbys Racing Bank Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
There's a strong possibility this could turn into a match with a couple of these declared earlier in the week. LIMERICK LEADER had the run of things when bolting up at Sedgefield last week and with that same scenario easy to envisage here, Nick Scolfield's 9-y-o can bring up the hat-trick. Fairlawn Skipper can chase him home should he take his chance.

  1. LIMERICK LEADER (FR)
  2. FAIRLAWN SKIPPER
  3. ROCKSTOWN GIRL (IRE)

races.name: In Memory Of Rossie Maitland-Carew Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CONQUER THE BREEZE hasn't looked back since joining current connections and having been freshened up by a 2-month break, Adam Nicol's 7-y-o is fancied to make it 5 wins from his last 6 outings. Duke of Luckley won a virtual non-event at Stratford just over 3 weeks ago and he can chase home the selection with his usual visor reapplied.

  1. CONQUER THE BREEZE (IRE)
  2. DUKE OF LUCKLEY (IRE)
  3. GARDE DES CHAMPS (IRE)

races.name: Join Racing TV For Free Now Open NH Hunt Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
LADY SCARPHIA makes appeal on paper as a half-sister to connections' dual bumper winner You Be Lucky Jean, so she could be up to doing the business on her debut. Going On is another newcomer to note, while Back In Favour sets the standard, though could prove vulnerable if the race develops into a sprint finish.

  1. LADY SCARPHIA
  2. GOING ON (IRE)
  3. BACK IN FAVOUR (IRE)

races.name: Trainor Stone & Tile Marble Handicap
races.verdict:
Competitive stuff with GOOD EARTH and Hint of Humour topping the shortlist back on their last winning marks, the former narrowly preferred. A stiff 5f could prove ideal for Forever Glamorous, while the well-bred Ardnamurchan is the least exposed in the field.

  1. GOOD EARTH (IRE)
  2. HINT OF HUMOUR
  3. FOREVER GLAMOROUS

races.name: Trainor Stone & Tile Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KINGDOM OF KUSH gets the vote on the back of a promising opening second at Newbury last month, although a strong market move for Charlie Appleby newcomer Altius would put a slightly different slant on things. Hierax is next on the list.

  1. KINGDOM OF KUSH (IRE)
  2. ALTIUS
  3. HIERAX

races.name: Trainor Stone & Tile EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Probably not a strong maiden and CHYMBULAK might be able to get the job done after taking a step forward from his debut when fifth in a traditionally-strong event at Ascot a fortnight ago. Saint of Seville and Caldo are a couple of interesting newcomers for leading connections.

  1. CHYMBULAK (IRE)
  2. SAINT OF SEVILLE
  3. CALDO

races.name: Trainor Stone & Tile Fortune Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
There should be more to come from promising 3-y-o CERRO BLANCO, who can take his record to 3-4 with the step up to 1m promising to be in his favour. Room Service has stamina to prove tackling 1m for the first time but will be a threat if reproducing the level he showed when landing a good-class handicap at Newcastle in the summer on his first outing for the Jamie Osborne yard. Centigrade remains open to progress and is next on the list ahead of Nahraan.

  1. CERRO BLANCO
  2. ROOM SERVICE (IRE)
  3. CENTIGRADE (IRE)

races.name: Inkerman Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
OH YES YOU DO's latest 1¼m course second looks solid and she gets the vote in this tight-looking handicap. Thursday Girl can easily be excused her latest C&D effort and is second choice ahead of last-time-out scorers Lightning Glory and Withtearsinmyeyes.

  1. OH YES YOU DO (FR)
  2. THURSDAY GIRL
  3. LIGHTNING GLORY (IRE)

races.name: Trainor Stone & Tile Handicap
races.verdict:
The progressive BRIGHTON BEACH was strong at the finish when third on her handicap bow at Goodwood last time, which offers plenty of encouragement that she can defy her current mark at this stiffer track. Barbury Boy is also on an upward curve so is next best ahead of Mythological Star.

  1. BRIGHTON BEACH (IRE)
  2. BARBURY BOY
  3. MYTHOLOGICAL STAR (IRE)

races.name: Trainor Stone & Tile Mosaic Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
TALITHA ROUGE looks capable of defying a penalty given how much she had in hand when off the mark at Redcar last week. Mmmbop remains with potential stepping up in trip on her second start for this yard so is next best ahead of Sweet Horizon and Mystic Music.

  1. TALITHA ROUGE (IRE)
  2. MMMBOP
  3. SWEET HORIZON

races.name: Clonmel Racecourse Supporters Club Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
SHANALA shaped well when third in a 21-runner event at Navan a fortnight ago, having to weave her way through in the straight before staying on well, and remains open to improvement. Noble Honour, placed 3 times previously, rates the chief threat back in maiden company, while Emily Estherfaye is worth a market check with handicaps an option after this.

  1. SHANALA (IRE)
  2. NOBLE HONOUR (IRE)
  3. EMILY ESTHERFAYE (IRE)

races.name: Slievenamon Maiden
races.verdict:
BLUE NASTURTIUM failed to stay 2m last time but had shaped with promise on debut and, with this marked drop in trip sure to suit, looks worth chancing in an ordinary maiden. Kakori sets the standard but has had plenty of chances and could be vulnerable to an improver, while Therewillbeglory is respected on the pick of her form.

  1. BLUE NASTURTIUM (IRE)
  2. KAKORI (IRE)
  3. THEREWILLBEGLORY (IRE)

races.name: Suir Blueway Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
CONCAIRE has shaped well in a couple of his recent starts and is taken to come good under Billy Lee. Mare Crisium shaped quite well at Navan last time and is second choice ahead of Cadreville.

  1. CONCAIRE (IRE)
  2. MARE CRISIUM (IRE)
  3. CADREVILLE (IRE)

races.name: Camida Gold Champion Handicap
races.verdict:
FEMME BEAUTY made a winning start for new connections and is taken to defy a 3 lb rise in an open handicap. Areana shaped well on return and rates the main danger if taking up this engagement rather than Tuesday’s Punchestown option, while Satono Chevalier and course-specialist Expound are also respected.

  1. FEMME BEAUTY (IRE)
  2. AREANA (IRE)
  3. SATONO CHEVALIER (IRE)

races.name: Camida Winning Solution Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
RESPONSE FINALE was unlucky not to go closer at Laytown last week and can notch a third win for the Cromwell yard. Last year's winner Chou Chou is highly respected, with Medieval Night also shortlisted after a couple of creditable efforts.

  1. REPONSE FINALE (IRE)
  2. CHOU CHOU (IRE)
  3. MEDIEVAL NIGHT (IRE)

races.name: Jerry McDonnell Memorial Tipperary Perpetual Cup Handicap
races.verdict:
NOT JUST ANY EAGLE hasn't won since spring 2025, but Patrick Flynn's 7-y-o has signalled his turn is imminent in recent weeks and now reunited with his usual pilot, gets the nod to notch career victory number 6. Lady Plimsoll made it 5 placings on the spin when runner-up at Killarney last month so she heads up the opposition, with Zoffman and Zanahiyr taken to fight out third.

  1. NOT JUST ANY EAGLE (IRE)
  2. LADY PLIMSOLL (IRE)
  3. ZOFFMAN (IRE)

races.name: John Thomas McNamara Series (Q.R.) Handicap
races.verdict:
GALLO DELL CIELO was most impressive at Tramore last month and is taken to defy a hefty rise, still leaving him below his last winning all-weather mark, and make it 4 wins from his last 5 starts. Rich Belief isn’t the force of old but won over hurdles a few months ago and should be suited by the return to a marathon trip on the Flat, while handicap debutant Highlander Addict is respected having previously won a bumper.

  1. GALLO DELL CIELO (IRE)
  2. RICH BELIEF
  3. HIGHLANDER ADDICT (IRE)

races.name: Season Finale Is Next Tuesday Selling Handicap
races.verdict:
MAO SHANG WONG is now operating only 1 lb above the mark he defied over C&D in the spring and encouragingly recaptured his peak form when finishing a good second at Newcastle 2 weeks ago. He has the services of a good value claimer back on board and shades preference over Bearwith and Great Blasket. 3-y-o Ohara is another worthy of a second look.

  1. MAO SHANG WONG (IRE)
  2. BEARWITH
  3. GREAT BLASKET (IRE)

races.name: Young Guns Nursery
races.verdict:
PRINCE KAMEO is progressing well for stable renowned for running up sequences and he may well be able to get his way out in front and complete the hat-trick. Court Legend is going the right way at this track and should be finishing well from further back so can give the selection most to think about.

  1. PRINCE KAMEO
  2. COURT LEGEND
  3. EMERALD BAY (IRE)

races.name: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Hull EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Albany fifth HIDDEN GIFT was below expectations in the Alice Keppel last time but still sets a clear standard back in novice company and can get the better of Myesme, who went close at Ayr on her highly-encouraging debut. Halliwell Stream also made a promising start to her career in the spring and remains open to progress.

  1. HIDDEN GIFT (IRE)
  2. MYESME
  3. HALLIWELL STREAM (IRE)

races.name: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
FLORAL MAID produced a promising debut effort when staying on strongly for second in a C&D maiden 17 days ago, likely to have won in another few strides and pulling well clear of the remainder. Looking sure to improve, she holds leading claims of going one place better second time up. Mubehir is also handily drawn and may provide chief resistance with Woodvale, who makes appeal on paper, one to note in the betting for clues on debut.

  1. FLORAL MAID (IRE)
  2. MUBEHIR (IRE)
  3. WOODVALE

races.name: We Are Christmas Party Central Handicap
races.verdict:
BRUMMELL turned in his best effort of the season when third in a race that is working out well at Doncaster last month and, successful on each of his 2 previous visits here, he could well be ready to strike reunited with his good value claimer. Almarada Prince has been holding his form very well and he's an obvious threat from a handy draw. Desert Treasure posted comfortably her best effort of the season from an unpromising position at Lingfield 3 weeks ago and is also high on the shortlist.

  1. BRUMMELL (IRE)
  2. ALMARADA PRINCE (IRE)
  3. DESERT TREASURE

races.name: EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ROKU NANA produced a promising first effort at Goodwood 18 days ago and this well-bred filly can build on that to open her account. Edward Bethell introduces 2 newcomers that make appeal on pedigrees so a market check regarding Benedetti and Engedi is advised as one of them could be the selection's biggest danger.

  1. ROKU NANA
  2. BENEDETTI
  3. ENGEDI (IRE)

races.name: Hurn Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
CASILLI has an outstanding Beverley record with 5 wins (3 over C&D) and, whilst on a 21-run losing sequence, her sixth at Ripon last month was likely needed after 12 months off and she's never encountered a race as weak as this before. She therefore could be the one to side with despite a poor draw. Copper And Five should be a threat back at this venue, while Itszaboy has the most to recommend him of the younger rivals.

  1. CASILLI
  2. COPPER AND FIVE
  3. ITSZABOY

races.name: Hurn Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
DUMFRIES has won twice at this track before and, like Hostelry, holds strong claims for Ruth Carr so it could be worth keeping an eye on the betting but slight preference is for the former as it stands. Willowinghurn could be the biggest danger if seeing out this trip.

  1. DUMFRIES
  2. HOSTELRY
  3. WILLOWINGHURN

races.name: Sea Deer Handicap
races.verdict:
MASSIMO BLUE is yet to really prove himself on turf but has thrived since joining Dylan Cunha and remains on a workable mark. He gets the nod. Dark Side Thunder and Deluded head the list of dangers.

  1. MASSIMO BLUE
  2. DARK SIDE THUNDER
  3. DELUDED (IRE)

races.name: British EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BIDSTA should have learnt plenty from her encouraging Newbury debut and can get off the mark here. Faith In Florence and Plastic Dream may give her most to think about.

  1. BIDSTA (IRE)
  2. FAITH IN FLORENCE (IRE)
  3. PLASTIC DREAM

races.name: EBF Future Stayers Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
William Haggas's newcomer DIVINE RHYTHM is out of a juvenile winner and may be able to follow in his dam's footsteps first time up here. Liberty's Hall looks the likeliest danger of those with experience.

  1. DIVINE RHYTHM (IRE)
  2. LIBERTY'S HALL
  3. DADDY STAR (IRE)

races.name: EBF Stallions John Musker Fillies' Stakes (Fillies' & Mares' Listed)
races.verdict:
FAIRY GLEN has been off since the spring, but this is a marked drop in grade and she's taken to make her class tell. Seet has improved with each run to date and may have further progress in the pipeline now tackling listed company for the first time over a trip she's bred to stay. Rhapsody is holding her form well and should give another good account back down in trip.

  1. FAIRY GLEN (FR)
  2. SEET
  3. RHAPSODY (IRE)

races.name: Goffs Two Million Series Handicap
races.verdict:
A useful handicap but the eye is drawn to ENOCH, who could step up better than a handicapper given the impression he's created so far. The assessor has been very fair with Point of Contact so he's second on the list, ahead of Masked Warrior.

  1. ENOCH (IRE)
  2. POINT OF CONTACT (IRE)
  3. MASKED WARRIOR

races.name: British EBF Premier Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Quite a few to consider here but on this more conventional track, ALICE DE CLARE will hopefully chart a straighter course and if that proves to be the case, there are further races to be won. Ladykirk is readily forgiven her last run and she can resume her progress, with Caraway also of interest at the foot of the weights.

  1. ALICE DE CLARE (IRE)
  2. LADYKIRK (IRE)
  3. CARAWAY

races.name: Eastern Power Systems Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
COURT DRIVE found plenty for pressure to secure win number 2 of 2026 over C&D 17 days ago and a 3 lb rise looks within range with Loughnane taking over. Remi Mae and Startled Lady were first and third in a Kempton handicap recently and both can remain very competitive.

  1. COURT DRIVE (IRE)
  2. REMI MAE
  3. STARTLED LADY

races.name: Prix De La Croix Falgarde Handicap
Grand Prix Du Centre Est-prix Paris-turf - Attele
Prix De La Boulangerie Fages - Attele
